profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack PHP (Symfony/Laravel) | Adobe Creative Cloud & Rive | Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps | Building Scalable Enterprise Solutions
profile.summary:
As a Full Stack Engineer, I enjoy building applications that are both technically solid and genuinely enjoyable to use. A lot of my work lives in the space between backend systems and frontend experience — designing APIs, working with databases and infrastructure, while also paying attention to interaction, motion, and the small details that make software feel intuitive.

I like experimenting with new tools and technologies and figuring out how they can fit into real-world products. Recently, I built a full motion-graphics driven website using Rive and JavaScript with a PHP backend, hosted on AWS with a Git-based deployment pipeline connected to my local Docker environment. Projects like that are what keep me excited about development — there’s always something new to learn and improve.

I’m especially interested in modern web experiences, AI-assisted workflows, and scalable cloud architecture, but I also try to stay grounded in the fundamentals: clean code, maintainable systems, good communication, and building software that actually helps people. I enjoy being part of teams that like to learn, collaborate well, and keep a sense of humor while solving difficult problems.
